decisions.reason: The vehicle_group field is already editable, and the source permits either a fixed vehicle-group line or a customer-specific assessed-vehicle line without necessarily changing the editable-field inventory.
Cleaning up the separate vehicle-group section does not require removing or changing vehicle-group information in report footers.
The vehicle-identification presentation refinement does not alter the current cross-variant visual theme or general design direction.
The vehicle-group display change is independent of the content and presentation of front-page result drivers.
The source does not require the revised vehicle-identification line to appear in internal headers, and the same message separately defines their content.
Changing the vehicle-identification section from checkboxes to a clean line does not change the score and risk result summary.
The final-page confidential distribution warning is unaffected by the vehicle-identification display choice.
The scoring table and its required fields remain valid regardless of how the assessed vehicle or vehicle group is displayed.
The vehicle-identification layout refinement does not change the required reusable fonts, icons, or design assets.
The source does not change the DX17–DX20 variant set, its editability, or its risk-based selection rule.
The revised vehicle-identification presentation does not affect the requirement for straightforward PDF export.
This candidate governs assessment-date placeholder copy; the separate vehicle-group or assessed-vehicle wording does not change that policy.
